description: The REFUSAL of the rename of a STRUCTURE ATTRIBUTE due to name collision. ProductSummary (base job:producer-public) already has the attributes Name and Price; renaming Price to Name has to be refused with the explanation that the Studio would silently suffix the name ('Name2') - a rename silently different from the one requested is worse than an error. It is the pre-check of the kernel, before touching the model: the module stays as it was. The clean path (attribute rename with expression rewrite, and rename of the structure itself) is in tests/jobs/structure-lifecycle.json.
expectError: rename: 'Name' clashes with an existing name in that scope

ops._why: the two siblings in the same scope: Name and Price. It is the Name that already exists that makes the next rename collide.

ops.name: Name
ops._why: refused with 'rename: 'Name' clashes with an existing name in that scope (the Studio would use 'Name2'); pick another name'. The op never gets to run: there are no consumers nor expressionsRewritten to read.
